title: WeaponFired
description: A unit fired a weapon at a target (CONTRACTS §6; COMBAT CB-2). The shot is not an entity; the outcome is not known yet (Q-GP-12). impact_tick is on the campaign clock (running ticks), not the tick counter: a pause delays the real tick, so it is not a Tick; a gun's equals the clock value of the tick it fired in. Public view: a hidden shooter shows no tracer (Q-CT-3).

target_id.description: The unit fired on; null for a shot at a node's defenses (then target_node_id is set; COMBAT CB-10).

target_node_id.description: The node whose defenses were fired on; null for a shot at a unit.

impact_tick.description: The campaign-clock tick the shot lands on.
